item.title: MEDMORALS SIGNUPS ARE OPEN
item.description: HEY HWA CHONG! 💛💙❤️💚 We are pleased to share MedMorals 2027: Debating Moral Dilemmas in Medicine, a student-led national medical ethics competition organised by MedSearch Singapore, open to students aged 13–18 from schools across Singapore! 🎉 MedMorals is designed to help students critically engage with complex moral questions in healthcare, going beyond what medicine can do to consider what medicine ought to do. Participants will investigate real-world healthcare dilemmas using credible evidence, examine ethical principles and competing perspectives, and develop their own reasoned position. 🏥🩺 Through the competition, students will develop ethical reasoning, critical analysis, research, communication and reflection skills, while gaining greater awareness of the human and social dimensions of healthcare. 🧠 1. What does MedMorals involve? Students may explore contemporary issues such as patient autonomy, end-of-life care, AI in healthcare, healthcare access, patient privacy and organ donation, or other healthcare ethics issues. Teams consist of 2–3 students and may comprise students from different schools and/or different educational levels Preliminary Round: Teams will research one real-world healthcare ethical dilemma and present their analysis through a digital A2 academic poster. The top 25–30 teams from the Preliminary Round will be invited to participate in the physical MedMorals 2027 Finals on 13–14 February 2027. 2. MedMorals 2027 Finals🔥 The two-day Finals programme is designed to provide finalists with opportunities to engage directly with healthcare ethics through: Panel discussions with healthcare professionals and ethics experts Interactive activities exploring ethical issues Oral presentations of their research and proposed solutions Q&A, where finalists will discuss and defend their perspectives before an interdisciplinary judging panel The Finals are planned across: 13 February 2027 – National University of Singapore (TBC) 14 February 2027 – SCAPE Singapore The competition has invited healthcare professionals and experts from fields including medicine, biomedical ethics, law, nursing and healthcare research to contribute to the Finals and judging process. 3. Awards and recognition🏅 The competition recognises excellence through several awards: Top 3 Finalist Teams Best Poster Most Creative Solution All participants will receive a certificate of participation, while all finalists will receive complimentary merchandise. The top 3 Finalists teams will receive exclusive prizes‼️ 4. International opportunity 🌍 MedMorals also includes an opportunity for international publication through the Student Medical Ethics Journal (SMEJ), an international platform for exploring ethical issues in medicine, clinical research and health policy. The Top 3 winning submissions will be featured on SMEJ's international journal website, giving students an opportunity to share their work with an international audience. 5. Eligibility MedMorals is open to students aged 13–18 from schools and institutions across Singapore. Teams consist of 2–3 students, and students may form teams across different schools and/or educational levels. You do not need prior knowledge of medical ethics to participate, and the competition is open to students with interests beyond medicine, including law, ethics, research, debate, public policy and social issues. 6. Key Dates 📅 23 November 2026, 2359 SGT – Registration closes 23 October–23 December 2026 – Preliminary poster submission period 23 December 2026, 2359 SGT – Poster submission closes 24 December 2026–7 January 2027 – Preliminary Round judging 8 January 2027 onwards – Finalists notified 13–14 February 2027 – MedMorals 2027 Finals Important: Teams must complete both the registration and poster submission forms for their submission to be considered complete. Students interested in participating should register by 23 November 2026, 2359 SGT. 7. Register for MedMorals 2027 📝 Registration Form: https://tinyurl.com/medmorals2027registration 8. Find out more! Further information on the competition structure, requirements, judging criteria and submission process can be found in the MedMorals 2027 Competition Information Deck and Preliminary Round Infosheet. Competition Information Deck : https://tinyurl.com/medmorals2027informationdeck Preliminary Round Infosheet: https://tinyurl.com/medmorals2027infosheet Poster Submission Form: https://tinyurl.com/medmorals2027postersubmission 9. Questions? If you have any questions about the competition, registration process or Preliminary Round, please feel free to contact Kevin (8806 7283), Charlotte (8876 6320), Chen Xi (9046 8526), Gideon (8938 9585) or Yingxuan (8897 8929) ARE YOU READY TO TAKE ON THE CHALLENGE?🏥🔥 Some questions do not have a single right answer. They require us to question assumptions, weigh different perspectives and decide what we believe. MedMorals 2027 gives you the opportunity to do exactly that through research, discussion and debate. Find your team. Choose a question worth exploring. Make your case. Registration closes 23 November 2026. We hope to see you at MedMorals 2027! 😁 ~MedSearch Singapore EXCO
